workflow.title: 6-Point Code Review Gate Workflow
workflow.gate: Does every database mutation and query enforce tenantId / userId ownership verification? Are inputs strictly sanitized?
Are there zero 'any' casts? Are domain states modeled as Discriminated Unions?
Do all API responses conform to the standard Envelope { success, data, error, meta }?
Do modified code paths include unit tests with AAA pattern or integration tests?
Are functions <= 40 lines? Do public APIs have TSDoc comments? Are Conventional Commits used?

Does any test claim concurrency locking, transaction isolation, or race-condition prevention? If yes, it MUST run on a real PostgreSQL engine (TEST-INT-001) or an active async mutex with concurrent Promise.all assertions (TEST-RACE-001). Pull Requests MUST NOT claim 'locking verified' when running on in-memory fake test doubles without concurrency mechanics (TEST-TRUTH-001). Comments stating 'Simulates X' are forbidden unless accompanied by verified runtime test assertions.
